details.description: KAT-Dev-72B-Exp is a 73-billion-parameter open-weight model from Kwaipilot, Kuaishou's AI team, that the maker describes as an experimental reinforcement-learning version of its proprietary KAT-Coder model, released to reveal the RL techniques behind KAT-Coder. It is built for software-engineering and code-generation tasks and is evaluated with the SWE-agent scaffold. It is released under the Apache 2.0 license.
advantages: Achieves 74.6% accuracy on SWE-bench Verified when evaluated with the SWE-agent scaffold, per Kwaipilot.
Uses a rewritten attention kernel that Kwaipilot says is optimized for reinforcement-learning training.
Uses advantage-distribution reshaping to prevent exploration collapse during reinforcement learning, per Kwaipilot.
disadvantages: Explicitly labeled experimental by Kwaipilot, released to demonstrate research techniques rather than as a finished product.
use_cases: Software-engineering and code-generation tasks evaluated as an autonomous SWE-agent
Research into large-scale reinforcement-learning training techniques for coding models

notes: The model card text I could access did not state an explicit base-model name (beyond a Qwen2-family tokenizer tag) or context-window figure, so the catalog's context facts (131072) are kept as authoritative without a directly comparable source figure.
